_comment: A type's provider is derived from its declared firmware's builder, not a provider: key - config.py and providers/pio.py each have to claim the right sections and leave the other's alone, or a type is silently built by the wrong tool, or dropped from the file entirely on the next save.

mutations.name: families built by different tools are refused
a platformio-only type is excluded from this registry
a platformio-only type's section survives a save
a type is selected by its declared firmware's builder
source comes from the family, not a leftover type-level key
env is required, never defaulted from the type name

mutations._comment: Absent inherits the next level out (the built-in default, klipper plus the watcher); present-but-empty still means klipper alone, never nothing. Easy to flatten into a single falsy check that treats both the same, which would wrongly inherit for a deliberate blank or wrongly override for an absent key.
mutations.name: an absent service: key is not the same as a blank one
